name: The Cotswold Garden Suzani Cotton Jacket
material: 100% Khadi Handloom Cotton & Silk Thread Embroidery
seoTitle: Cotswold Garden Suzani Cotton Jacket | Textile Jaipur
seoDescription: Handcrafted Cotswold floral Suzani jacket in pure khadi cotton. Artisanal silk embroidery with free express worldwide shipping from Textile Jaipur.
productDescription:
Immerse yourself in artisanal splendor with The Cotswold Garden Suzani Cotton Jacket, a masterwork of slow-fashion luxury tailored by heritage needleworkers in Jaipur. Stitched onto structured organic handloom khadi cotton, this piece showcases a botanical tapestry of blossoming floral rosettes, wandering ivy vines, and traditional solar medallions inspired by historic Central Asian and Rajasthani court textiles. Every stitch is placed by hand using vibrant silk floss threads, creating rich dimensional relief and heirloom longevity.

Designed with an effortless open-front silhouette, clean bound neckline, and deep patch pockets, this statement outerwear piece merges historic craftsmanship with contemporary cosmopolitan ease. Breathable yet substantial, it drapes comfortably through the shoulders and layers seamlessly over casual denim or evening slip dresses, honoring mindful sustainable craft with every wear.
culturalContext: Originating along the ancient Silk Road and refined over centuries in Rajasthani artisan havelis, Suzani needlework represents celebration, heritage, and female artisan empowerment. Each jacket requires between 30 to 50 hours of meticulous chain-stitch and satin-stitch needlecraft, preserving generational folk art outside industrialized mass production.
stylingAdvice: Pair with high-rise ecru trousers, a crisp linen tank, and pointed leather mules for an elevated city daytime look, or drape over a bias-cut black silk slip dress with vintage gold bangles for timeless twilight dining.

Indulge in nocturnal elegance with the Black Velvet Suzani Embroidered Short Kimono Jacket from Textile Jaipur. Tailored from lustrous, midnight-black micro-velvet, this sumptuous jacket serves as a dramatic canvas for dense silk-thread floral embroidery in jewel-tone golds, crimson, and turquoise. The velvety nap catches the ambient light with every movement, creating a luminous contrast against the intricate artisanal needlepoint inspired by royal Mughal and Ottoman court robes.

Cut in a modern short kimono silhouette with relaxed kimono sleeves and an open front, this piece transitions effortlessly from festive gatherings to elevated evening galas. Lined with smooth, breathable cotton voile for all-evening comfort, it envelops the wearer in plush warmth (ideal for 5°C–18°C) while maintaining an architectural yet fluid bohemian line.
culturalContext: Combining Japanese kimono silhouette geometry with centuries-old Rajasthani Aari and Suzani needlework traditions, this piece reflects Jaipur's historic role as a cosmopolitan textile crossroad where global garment forms meet generational Indian embellishment arts.
stylingAdvice: Layer over a monochrome black turtleneck and wide-leg satin trousers with velvet platform heels, or contrast with distressed girlfriend jeans and gold statement hoops for effortless rock-and-roll bohemian glamour.

Command attention in the Royal Indigo Silk-Thread Suzani TNT Jacket, a bold testament to Jaipur's iconic indigo dyeing and needlepoint heritage. Constructed from premium heavy-weight cotton TNT canvas, this structured jacket provides reliable durability and wind-breaking comfort while serving as the canvas for radiating solar discs, pomegranate blossoms, and scrolling leaves. stylingAdvice: Balance the vibrant cobalt palette with head-to-toe white linen separates and tan woven leather huaraches, or style with a camel turtleneck and indigo flared denim for a 70s-inspired silhouette.

name: Ivory Bloom Reversible Kantha Stitch Worker Jacket
material: Vintage Kantha Quilted Handloom Cotton with Wooden Button Accents
seoTitle: Reversible Kantha Stitch Quilted Jacket | Textile Jaipur
seoDescription: Hand-quilted reversible Kantha cotton worker jacket from Jaipur. Upcycled vintage artistry with coconut buttons and free worldwide shipping at Textile Jaipur.
productDescription:
Double your wardrobe versatility with the Ivory Bloom Reversible Kantha Stitch Worker Jacket, an authentic masterclass in circular slow fashion. Crafted from layers of handloom cotton quilted together using thousands of continuous micro-running stitches (Kantha), this jacket reveals a delicate botanical block print on one side and a minimalist textured geometric reverse. Accented with natural carved coconut shell buttons and patch pockets on both faces, you enjoy two distinct handcrafted jackets in one singular garment.

The gently quilted layers provide natural thermal insulation without synthetic bulk, making this jacket an indispensable companion across transitional seasons. Softened through traditional wash cycles, the fabric molds uniquely to the wearer's body over time, embodying the soulful warmth of heritage domestic Indian textile craftsmanship.
culturalContext: Kantha is one of the world's oldest upcycling art forms, born in rural India where women hand-stitched layers of repurposed cotton sarees into quilted heirlooms. The rhythmic running stitch represents familial blessing, protection, and devotion to sustainable craft.
stylingAdvice: Wear the floral side forward with olive green cargo trousers and chunky combat boots for effortless utilitarian chic, then flip to the geometric reverse over an oatmeal knit dress for understated rustic minimalism.

name: Bagru Dabu Hand-Block Printed Cotton Kimono Robe
material: Pure Mulmul Cotton with Natural Plant Dyes (Mud-Resist Dabu)
seoTitle: Bagru Hand-Block Print Cotton Kimono | Textile Jaipur
seoDescription: Handcrafted Bagru Dabu mud-resist block print cotton kimono robe. Pure mulmul fabric with natural dyes. Free express worldwide shipping at Textile Jaipur.
productDescription:
Breathe in effortless bohemian freedom with the Bagru Dabu Hand-Block Printed Cotton Kimono Robe. Crafted in the renowned artisan village of Bagru outside Jaipur, this flowing duster robe is stamped by hand using carved teak wood blocks and a traditional mud-resist paste (Dabu). Dyed in natural indigo and fermented harda tannins, the fabric achieves an organic botanical rhythm that cannot be replicated by modern industrial machinery.

Cut from feather-light, cloud-soft mulmul cotton (ideal for 18°C–30°C), this versatile garment features dramatic wide kimono sleeves, an open draping front, and a detachable fabric sash belt. Whether draped as a poolside resort cover-up, worn open as a romantic street duster, or tied as elevated morning loungewear, it represents the epitome of conscious artisan luxury.
culturalContext: Dabu block printing is a 400-year-old mud-resist technique practiced by the Chippa community of Bagru. The artisans hand-press mud, sawdust, and gum onto cotton cloth before submerging it into subterranean indigo vats, washing the fabric in open-air river basins under the desert sun.
stylingAdvice: Drape loosely over high-waisted linen shorts and an ivory swimwear bandeau at coastal resorts, or style over a white ribbed tank and straight cropped denim with metallic sandals for balmy summer city evenings.

seoTitle: Jaipur Marigold Tiered Cotton Maxi Dress | Textile Jaipur
seoDescription: Hand-block printed Marigold bohemian tiered maxi dress in airy cotton. Sanganeri floral prints with free worldwide shipping directly from Textile Jaipur.
productDescription:
Radiate sunlit joy with the Jaipur Marigold Tiered Bohemian Summer Maxi Dress, a festive tribute to Rajasthan's vibrant celebratory flower markets. Tailored from premium 100% cambric cotton, this tiered silhouette is stamped with delicate Sanganeri floral motifs using carved wooden blocks. The radiant golden marigold blossoms and gentle sage vine borders dance across three flowing gathered tiers, designed to catch the breeze and twirl with effortless grace.

Featuring an adjustable split neckline with hand-tied tassels, discreet side pockets, and gentle blouson sleeves with soft elastic cuffs, this dress combines vacation comfort with romantic polish. Lined in lightweight cotton for opacity without heat retention, it seamlessly guides you from sun-drenched garden parties to evening seaside strolls.
culturalContext: Marigolds (Genda Phool) hold sacred status in Rajasthan, symbolizing auspicious beginnings, vibrant energy, and joy. Sanganeri block printing, protected by Geographical Indication (GI), has been practiced in Jaipur since the 16th century under royal patronage.
stylingAdvice: Style with woven raffia platform wedges, a wide-brim straw hat, and turquoise beaded earrings for daytime winery visits, or cinched at the waist with an embossed leather belt and ankle booties for rustic evening chic.
